name: ISD1820 Voice Recording & Playback Module
description: Single-chip voice recording and playback module with onboard microphone, 10-second non-volatile audio memory, and direct 8-ohm speaker driver.
realWorldAnalogy: Single-chip voice recording and playback module with onboard microphone, 10-second non-volatile audio memory, and direct 8-ohm speaker driver.

hazards: Keep speaker away from magnetic storage devices

wiringGuidance: Connect VCC to 5V, GND to GND, and PLAYE to Arduino digital pin 8. Connect the included 2-pin mini speaker to the SP+ and SP- terminals.
commonMistakes: Holding the REC button too far from your mouth when recording audio.
Forgetting to set REC pin to LOW during normal operation.

miniExperiment.title: Robot Voice Trigger
miniExperiment.circuit: Connect VCC to 5V, GND to GND, PLAYE to Pin 8. Connect speaker to module.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The speaker plays your recorded message 2 seconds after startup.
